en: The postcard features a colorized image of a park scene with tall trees, a central fountain, and benches along a walkway. Handwritten text is visible on the right side of the image. The word 'Sköfde' and 'Parken.' appear at the bottom, suggesting the location is a park in Skövde. The reverse side shows Swedish text, a 5 öre green stamp from Sweden, postmark from Vänersborg (dated 1908), and the address written to a Fröken Camille Gvelin in Vänersborg.
